common.aiBudgetExceeded: This company has reached its daily AI limit. Please try again tomorrow.

auth.loadFailed: We could not load your account. Check your connection and try again.

password.title: Change password
password.forcedHint: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.rejected: Choose a new password of at least 10 characters that differs from the current one.

banner.sampleHint: This company contains sample data for demonstration only.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.noCompany: This account is not a member of any company.
settings.readOnlyNote: Only HR members can change company settings.

members.title: Members
members.name: Member name (optional)
members.existingAccount: This email already had an account. Confirm with this person that the account is theirs before relying on this membership.

demoAi.notice: Demo AI: this content comes from a built-in demo provider, not a real AI model. Do not rely on it.

documents.title: Documents
documents.formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown. Extracted items wait in Review until HR accepts them.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Upload a policy, handbook or job description above to start building the company knowledge.
documents.partial: Partly processed: {{dropped}} items dropped and {{failed}} sections failed. Review what was extracted before relying on it.
documents.held: Not published yet, so its text stays out of answers: {{dropped}} items were dropped and {{failed}} sections or checks failed. What was not read may say something you would have hidden.
documents.publishAnywayConfirm: Publish "{{title}}" anyway? {{dropped}} items were dropped and {{failed}} sections or checks failed, so nothing has reviewed that text, and all of it becomes readable.
documents.conflictMessage: This document has changed since the page loaded, so the action was not applied. The list is refreshed. ({{detail}})
documents.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw "{{title}}"? Its content stops being used by the Copilot and the graph, and knowledge items with no other source document are removed.
documents.withdrawn: Document withdrawn. {{removed}} items removed, {{kept}} kept because another document supports them.

maskingNotes.names_unchecked: The names in this intake transcript could not be checked, so only patterns such as emails and phone numbers were removed. The raw transcript is kept for now. It stays unpublished until you mask the names again. It is erased after 7 days either way.
maskingNotes.unknown: This document was not fully masked. Read it before approving anything from it.

reasons.document_withdrawn: Back for review: a document it also came from was withdrawn. Check that its text does not repeat what that document said.

review.title: Review
review.empty: Nothing to review. Upload a document and its extracted items will appear here.
review.mergeHint: Looks like the existing item "{{title}}" ({{percent}}% similar).

guard.uncheckedTitle: The automatic discrimination check did not run
guard.flaggedTitle: Blocked: asks for a protected trait ({{category}})
guard.uncheckedHint: Read this item yourself. If it is fine, accept it and confirm that you reviewed it.
guard.flaggedHint: This item cannot be accepted as it is. Reject it, or rewrite the title or body so that it does not ask for a protected trait.
guard.confirmMessage: Confirm that you read this item and it does not ask for a protected trait.

review.maskingHeld: The names in "{{title}}" were not masked. Its items need your careful reading and the document stays unpublished until masking is retried.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.intro: Two documents disagree. Keep one value, or mark them as covering different scopes.
conflicts.empty: No open conflicts. New ones appear here when an uploaded document disagrees with existing knowledge.

gaps.title: Knowledge gaps
gaps.intro: Questions the Copilot could not answer, grouped by topic.
gaps.heading: Documents to write
gaps.empty: No unanswered questions. When someone asks something the knowledge does not cover, it is listed here so you can write the missing document.

graph.title: Knowledge graph
graph.subtitle: What the company knowledge looks like for each audience.
graph.simulateNote: This switch only simulates what each audience can read. It is read-only and changes no one's access.
graph.empty: No nodes are visible to this audience.
graph.loadFailed: We could not load the graph. Try again.
graph.noSelection: Select a node in the graph or the list to see its details.
graph.hint: Drag nodes to rebalance them. Click a node to inspect it.
graph.layerConfirm: Move this node to the {{layer}} layer? Who can read it changes right away.
graph.unpublishConfirm: Unpublish this node? It stops being used by the Copilot and disappears from the graph.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.subtitle: Ask about company policies and documents. Answers come only from documents you are allowed to read.
copilot.conflictNotice: Two company sources differ on this. Nothing is asserted until HR confirms which applies.
copilot.notFoundNotice: This was not found in the documents you can read. The question was recorded for HR.

errors.unavailable: Company knowledge is not searchable yet. The operator needs to rebuild the search index.
errors.provider: The AI service did not respond. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Copilot could not answer this question. Please try again.

trust.title: Trust Center
trust.intro: Consents, the audit log, data retention and the fairness check for your company.
trust.legalNote: Consent wording and retention periods are proposals and have not had legal review.

consents.intro: Each candidate consent is listed under the candidate's alias. Names and email addresses are not shown.

audit.intro: Every decision, reveal and AI step is recorded here. Candidates appear only as application numbers.

retention.periodHint: Undecided applications are removed after {{undecided}} days.
retention.awaitingHint: Applications that still hold personal data.
retention.dueNowHint: Past their retention period; the next scheduled run deletes them.
retention.anonymizedHint: Personal data deleted; the status record remains.
retention.deleted: the CV file and text, interview recordings and transcripts, assessment results, consents and notifications for the application, and the link between audit entries and the candidate.
retention.kept: the application's alias, stage and decision, and the audit log, so hiring statistics and accountability remain.

fairness.intro: Swaps the name and gender in an application's CV, masks it again, and compares the blind text. Nothing is rescored and nothing about the application changes.
fairness.resultSame: After swapping name and gender, the blind text is identical and the stored screening result is the same.
fairness.resultTextSameOnly: After swapping name and gender, the blind text is identical, but the stored screening results could not be confirmed as the same.
fairness.resultTextDiffers: After swapping name and gender, the blind text differs, although the stored screening results are the same. Compare the two texts below.
fairness.resultDiffers: After swapping name and gender, the blind text differs and the stored screening results are not the same. Compare the two texts below.
fairness.limit: School names and experience content remain, so this reduces bias but does not eliminate it.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.roleHint: Choosing a role fills in the title, description and requirements from the company knowledge. You can edit everything.
jobs.descriptionHint: Write or edit the description here. To draft one from the company knowledge, open a hiring request and use JD Studio.
jobs.visibilityHint: Only public requirements are shown to candidates on the public job page.
jobs.versionNotice: Changing requirements creates a new version. Existing applications keep the version they applied to.
jobs.confirmClose: Close this job? It will no longer accept applications.
jobs.closedNotice: This job is closed and can no longer be edited.
jobs.languageRequired: Choose at least one interview language.
jobs.channelsHint: Share each link on its channel. Clicks are counted per link.
jobs.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
jobs.channelInvalid: Use 1 to 50 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
jobs.noPublicRequirement: This job has no public requirement. The interview has nothing to measure, so every candidate's evidence band will be low.
jobs.descriptionInJdStudio: This job was made in JD Studio. Edit its description there, so the checks and the manager's approval apply.

board.title: Candidate board
board.intro: Candidates appear under an alias. Read the answers first; identity stays hidden until you choose to reveal it. AI only suggests. Approval and rejection are your decisions.

axes.notMet: CV does not meet the requirements

priority.title: Priority
priority.hint: The CV fits and the interview backed it up.

strong_cv_unclear.title: Strong CV, unclear answers
strong_cv_unclear.hint: The CV fits, but the answers did not make it clear.

hidden_gem.title: Hidden Gem
hidden_gem.axes: CV does not meet, much evidence
hidden_gem.hint: The CV falls short, but the interview showed real evidence.
hidden_gem.callout: A CV filter would have missed these.

not_enough_evidence.title: Not enough evidence
not_enough_evidence.axes: CV does not meet, little evidence
not_enough_evidence.hint: Neither the CV nor the interview gave enough to go on.

board.fastTrackedNote: This candidate was fast-tracked without an interview, so there is no interview evidence.
board.cvConsentWithdrawn: This candidate withdrew consent to CV processing, so AI no longer works on this CV and they cannot be invited to the interview.
board.anonymizedNotice: This candidate's data has been deleted. There is nothing left to review and no action is available.
board.analysisFailed: The analysis of this interview failed. You can retry it.
board.hiddenText: Note: the CV file contained hidden text, which was ignored.

bulk.confirm: You are about to reject {{count}} candidates. This cannot be undone.

transcript.title: Interview transcript
transcript.empty: There is no interview transcript for this candidate.
transcript.question: Question
transcript.unavailable: No transcript is available for this answer.
transcript.maskedNote: Names, emails, phone numbers and similar details are hidden until you reveal the candidate. Anything else they said about themselves may remain.

evidence.title: Requirements: CV and interview side by side

claims.title: CV claims
claims.empty: No claims were extracted from the CV.

culture.title: Culture notes
culture.hint: Notes per company value, with the words that support them. These are not scored.
culture.empty: No culture notes for this candidate.

suggestion.title: AI suggestion, for your review
suggestion.none: There is no AI suggestion for this candidate.

audio.failed: The recording could not be played.

actions.title: Your decision
actions.rejectConfirm: Reject this candidate? The candidate will be told that the hiring team decided not to move forward. This cannot be undone.

reveal.title: Reveal identity
reveal.confirm: Reveal this candidate's name and email? The reveal is recorded in the audit log.

board.transcriptionFailed: This candidate answered, but speech-to-text failed. The audio is available. This is a technical problem, not a missing interview. You can retry the transcription.
board.cvFailed: This candidate's CV could not be processed, so AI has not looked at it. You can invite them to the interview anyway.

requests.title: Hiring requests
requests.noManagers: This company has no manager members yet. Add one in Company settings first.

status.intake_empty: No answer was recorded. Start the intake again

requests.cancelConfirm: Cancel this hiring request? Its intake, drafts and approval stop, and it cannot be reopened.

intake.title: Manager intake
intake.noticeTranscript: A transcript of your answers goes to HR for review. HR decides what is used.
intake.noticeNoNames: Please do not name individual people in your answers. Speak about roles and situations.
intake.understood: I have read this and I am ready to start the recorded session.
intake.completed: Thank you. Your answers have been sent and HR will review them.
intake.alreadyDone: The intake for this request is already done.
intake.notFound: This hiring request was not found.

voice.micHint: Test your microphone and watch the level move while you speak.
voice.micError: The microphone could not be opened. Allow microphone access in the browser and try again.
voice.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge or Safari.
voice.uploadFailed: Your answer could not be sent. Check your connection and send it again.
voice.recordError: Recording failed. Check your microphone and try again.
voice.closing: The session is about to close.
voice.repeat: We could not hear you clearly. Please answer the same question again.

brief.title: Interview brief
brief.hint: Drafted by AI from the evidence. You review it and send it; the AI decides nothing.
brief.replacesNote: Generating replaces any earlier draft and clears its review.
brief.regenerateConfirm: Replace the current draft and clear its review?
brief.noEvidence: There is no interview evidence for this candidate yet.
brief.reviewFirst: Mark the brief as reviewed before sending it.
brief.sentNote: Sent to the hiring manager. It can no longer be edited.
brief.stale: The interview was analysed again after this brief was made. Generate it again to use the new evidence.
brief.staleSent: The interview was analysed again after this brief was sent. Generate it again, review it and send the new one.

interviews.title: My interviews
interviews.empty: No interview briefs have been sent to you yet.
interviews.identityLogged: HR approved this candidate. Opening this page is recorded in the audit log.
interviews.briefHint: Quotes are shown in the language they were said or written in.
interviews.recordingHeld: Recordings are held by HR. Ask HR to play a moment if you need to hear it.

scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.hint: Score each requirement from 1 to 5 and give your recommendation. HR makes the final decision.
scorecard.submitted: Your scorecard is submitted. You can change it and submit again.

hrView.title: Hiring managers' scorecards
hrView.hint: Advice for you. HR makes the final decision; nothing changes automatically.
hrView.none: No hiring manager has submitted a scorecard yet.

outcome.title: Hiring outcome
outcome.hint: Record what happened. HR records this; the AI does not.

jd.title: JD Studio

hint.draft: Edit the lines or ask the assistant, then submit the draft to the manager.
hint.draftManager: HR is still editing this draft. You will be able to approve it once HR submits it.
hint.manager_review: Submitted. Waiting for the manager to read and approve it.
hint.manager_reviewManager: Read the description in your language. Approve it if it is right.
hint.approved: The manager approved this version. HR can publish it.
hint.approvedManager: You approved this version. HR can publish it.
hint.published: This description is published. Editing it again needs a new approval.
hint.blocked: Fix what blocks the draft, or complete the missing languages, before you submit it.

jd.rejected: {{count}} generated line(s) were left out because the knowledge graph does not support them.
jd.noLines: This draft has no lines yet.
jd.unsupported: Its source does not say this

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.hint: Ask for a change in wording, length or tone. The assistant never adds a salary, benefit or requirement the knowledge graph does not hold; it proposes it and you decide.
assistant.proposed: Proposed line, not in the draft yet

lint.title: Checks
lint.acknowledge: Acknowledge: the check could not run

messages.discrimination: A line may ask for something about the person rather than the job. HR must change it before it can be published.
messages.no_source: A line has no source in the company knowledge. HR must add a source or confirm it.
messages.conflict: A line states a different value than a company fact. HR must fix it before it can be published.
messages.unchecked: An automatic check could not run on a line. HR must run it again or review the line.
messages.must_have_count: This draft has many must-have requirements, which narrows the pool of candidates.
messages.other: A check found an issue with this draft.

channels.title: Channel content
channels.manualNotice: Copy and post by hand. This system does not post to job boards.
channels.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
channels.usedTemplate: The AI text was not used for this channel: it added a fact, or the fairness check flagged it or could not run. This text is built from the job description lines only.

rejectedReasons.no_source: It has no source in the company knowledge.
rejectedReasons.unknown_nodes: It cites knowledge that is not available.
rejectedReasons.unsupported_numbers: It states numbers that its sources do not contain: {{numbers}}.
rejectedReasons.unsupported_terms: It names a salary or benefit that its sources do not mention.
rejectedReasons.unknown: The company knowledge does not support it.

insights.simulatedNote: These rows are labelled demo data. They show how the page works, not a real effect.

channels.title: Channel Intelligence
channels.intro: Which channels bring people HR approves, and at what cost. Every figure is counted by code.
channels.empty: No applications or costs for this job yet.
channels.smallSample: Sample too small, treat as a hint
channels.commentaryHint: An AI explanation of the table above, only when you ask. It may only use figures in the table.
channels.noCommentary: No commentary is available. The table above is complete without it.
channels.costHint: Enter what you spent on a channel in a month, or import a CSV with the columns channel, period_month, amount_vnd. A channel with no cost shows "Not entered".

reality.title: Requirement Reality Check
reality.intro: For each must-have, how many of the people you hired held it. This only suggests: nothing changes until you edit the job yourself.
reality.probationNote: Probation counts as passed only when the result is "passed". An extended probation does not count as passed.
reality.empty: This job has no active must-have requirements.
reality.notEnough: {{hired}} hired so far. The rule needs at least {{min}}.
reality.heldBy: {{with}} of {{hired}} hired people held this requirement.
reality.tooStrict: HR has corrected this label to "meets" often: the requirement may be read too strictly.
reality.thresholdsHint: Below the low share the rule suggests a nice-to-have, above the high share it keeps the requirement, and with fewer hires than the minimum it says not enough data.

feedback.title: Feedback to the candidate
feedback.intro: Nothing is sent until you approve it. The message never mentions screening labels, confidential topics or other candidates.

source.template_guard: Standard message (the AI draft was not safe to send)

feedback.noLearning: No catalogue entry matches this message.
feedback.redraftConfirm: Replace the text above, including anything you changed, with a new draft?

queue.title: Feedback drafts waiting: {{count}}
queue.intro: Alias and the start of each message only. Open one to read and edit it.
queue.blocked: {{alias}} blocks the batch, and nothing was sent: {{reasons}}

talent.title: Talent pool matches
talent.intro: People who agreed to be considered again. Aliases only. Finding matches uses the AI, so it runs when you ask.
talent.none: No one in the talent pool matches this job.

learning.title: Learning catalogue
learning.intro: Feedback links only to entries in this list. If no entry fits, no link is suggested.
learning.name: Title

problems.label_wording: It mentions a screening label or result
problems.comparison: It compares the candidate with others
problems.unverified_quote: It quotes words the candidate did not say
problems.unknown_link: It links to a page that is not in your learning catalogue
problems.candidate_gone: The candidate's data has been deleted
problems.changed: The text changed after you read it

start.title: Onboarding
start.hint: Drafts a 30-60-90 day plan from the team's knowledge. The AI only proposes; you and the manager edit and approve it.

plan.title: Onboarding plan
plan.usedInterview: Built from the team's knowledge and, with the hire's consent, skills their interview did not confirm.
plan.teamKnowledgeOnly: Built from the team's knowledge only.
plan.sourceHidden: a page the hire cannot read
plan.approveConfirm: Approve this plan? The hire becomes an employee of the company and sees this checklist.

probation.title: Probation result
probation.hint: Recorded by a person. Nothing here is predicted by AI.

mine.title: My onboarding
mine.privacy: Only the time you tick an item is stored. Your manager and HR do not see which items you have done.
mine.empty: You have no onboarding plan yet.
